hints.title: Propagate Ancestor Parity
hints.text: During tree traversal, pass the parity or value of the parent and grandparent down the recursive calls.

hints.title: Check Grandparent Parity
hints.text: If the grandparent value is even, add the current node value to the total sum.

hints.title: DFS Parameter Shift
hints.text: Recurse: dfs(node.left, parent_val=node.val, grand_val=parent_val) and similarly for node.right.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looking downwards two generations at every node repeats node inspections across generations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Passing parent and grandparent values down the recursion stack inspects each node exactly once.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate cleanly passes ancestor state down tree recursion.
complexity.notes: Initial parent and grandparent parameters are odd (e.g. 1) to indicate non-even ancestors.
